hubs.seo_title: Best Sleep Apps & Tools 2026 | Evidence-Based | HeyPsych
hubs.meta_description: Compare the best sleep apps including CBT-i Coach, Calm, and more. Evidence-based tools for insomnia, sleep tracking, and better rest.
hubs.direct_answer: The best sleep apps combine CBT-i (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia) techniques with sleep tracking and relaxation features. CBT-i Coach is the gold standard for insomnia treatment, while apps like Calm excel at relaxation and sleep stories.
hubs.intro: Sleep is foundational to mental health. These evidence-based apps and tools can help you fall asleep faster, stay asleep longer, and wake up more refreshed. We've reviewed each tool for clinical evidence, privacy practices, and real user experiences.

faqs.q: What is the best app for insomnia?
faqs.a: CBT-i Coach, developed by the VA, is the best free app for insomnia. It uses Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-i), which is the first-line treatment recommended by sleep medicine specialists. For a more premium experience, Calm and Headspace offer sleep-focused content.

faqs.q: Do sleep apps actually work?
faqs.a: Yes, when based on evidence. Apps using CBT-i techniques have strong research support showing they can reduce insomnia symptoms. Relaxation and meditation apps can help with sleep onset but aren't treatments for clinical insomnia.

faqs.q: Are sleep tracking apps accurate?
faqs.a: Consumer sleep trackers are moderately accurate for total sleep time but less accurate for sleep stages. They're useful for identifying patterns but shouldn't replace clinical sleep studies for diagnosing sleep disorders.

hubs.seo_title: Best Anxiety & Stress Apps 2026 | CBT-Based | HeyPsych
hubs.meta_description: Find the best apps for anxiety and stress relief. Compare Rootd, MindShift CBT, and more evidence-based tools for managing anxiety symptoms.
hubs.direct_answer: The best anxiety apps use CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy) techniques to help you identify anxious thoughts, challenge them, and develop coping skills. Rootd is excellent for panic attacks, while MindShift CBT offers comprehensive anxiety management.
hubs.intro: Anxiety affects millions of people, and the right tools can make a real difference. These apps offer evidence-based techniques like CBT, exposure therapy guidance, and relaxation exercises to help you manage anxiety and stress.

faqs.q: What is the best free app for anxiety?
faqs.a: MindShift CBT is one of the best free anxiety apps, offering CBT-based tools for various anxiety types. Rootd has a free version focused on panic attacks. Both are developed with input from mental health professionals.

faqs.q: Can anxiety apps replace therapy?
faqs.a: Anxiety apps can complement therapy but typically shouldn't replace it for moderate to severe anxiety. They're excellent for mild anxiety, between-session practice, or while waiting for therapy access.

faqs.q: What type of therapy do anxiety apps use?
faqs.a: Most evidence-based anxiety apps use Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) techniques, which help you identify and change unhelpful thought patterns. Some also incorporate mindfulness, exposure exercises, and relaxation training.

hubs.seo_title: Best Depression & Mood Apps 2026 | Mood Tracking | HeyPsych
hubs.meta_description: Compare top apps for depression and mood tracking. Daylio, Moodfit, and more tools to monitor your mood and support mental wellness.
hubs.direct_answer: The best mood and depression apps combine mood tracking with CBT techniques and behavioral activation. Daylio excels at simple mood journaling, while Moodfit offers a comprehensive approach with CBT exercises and goal setting.
hubs.intro: Tracking your mood is a proven way to understand patterns and triggers. These apps help you monitor your emotional state, identify what affects your mood, and build habits that support mental wellness.

faqs.q: Do mood tracking apps help with depression?
faqs.a: Research shows mood tracking can increase self-awareness and help identify patterns. When combined with CBT techniques, mood apps can be helpful tools for mild to moderate depression. They're not replacements for clinical treatment.

faqs.q: What is the best mood tracker app?
faqs.a: Daylio is the most popular mood tracker for its simplicity and visual approach. Moodfit offers more features including CBT exercises. The best choice depends on whether you want simple tracking or comprehensive mental health tools.

faqs.q: How often should I track my mood?
faqs.a: Most experts recommend tracking at least once daily, ideally at a consistent time. Some people benefit from multiple check-ins per day. Consistency is more important than frequency.

hubs.seo_title: Best ADHD & Focus Apps 2026 | Productivity Tools | HeyPsych
hubs.meta_description: Find the best apps for ADHD and focus. Compare tools for time management, task organization, and focus improvement.
hubs.direct_answer: The best ADHD apps help with executive function challenges like time management, task initiation, and focus. Wysa offers AI-powered CBT support, while specialized ADHD apps provide timers, reminders, and organization tools.
hubs.intro: Living with ADHD or focus challenges requires the right tools. These apps help with time blindness, task management, and building sustainable routines. We've selected tools that understand the unique needs of the ADHD brain.

faqs.q: What apps help with ADHD?
faqs.a: The best ADHD apps address executive function challenges: Wysa for emotional support, body doubling apps for focus, and task managers designed for ADHD brains. Look for apps with visual timers, flexible reminders, and gamification.

faqs.q: Can apps help me focus with ADHD?
faqs.a: Yes, the right apps can help. Focus timers (like Pomodoro apps), body doubling, and apps that provide external structure can compensate for executive function challenges. They work best alongside other ADHD treatments.

faqs.q: Are ADHD apps a replacement for medication?
faqs.a: No. Apps are tools that can complement medication and therapy, not replace them. They're most effective as part of a comprehensive ADHD management plan that may include medication, therapy, and lifestyle strategies.

hubs.seo_title: Best PTSD & Trauma Apps 2026 | Evidence-Based | HeyPsych
hubs.meta_description: Compare evidence-based apps for PTSD and trauma. PTSD Coach, Insight Timer, and more tools developed with trauma specialists.
hubs.direct_answer: PTSD Coach, developed by the VA, is the leading free app for PTSD. It provides psychoeducation, self-assessment, and coping tools based on evidence-based treatments. Insight Timer offers trauma-informed meditations.
hubs.intro: Trauma recovery requires specialized, evidence-based approaches. These apps have been developed with trauma specialists and offer tools for managing symptoms, grounding, and supporting your healing journey. They complement but don't replace trauma therapy.

faqs.q: What is the best app for PTSD?
faqs.a: PTSD Coach, developed by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, is the gold standard. It's free, evidence-based, and provides tools for managing PTSD symptoms, tracking progress, and finding professional support.

faqs.q: Can apps help with trauma symptoms?
faqs.a: Apps can help manage trauma symptoms but aren't replacements for trauma therapy. They're useful for grounding techniques, psychoeducation, and between-session practice. Trauma-informed therapy remains the primary treatment.

faqs.q: Are meditation apps safe for trauma?
faqs.a: Some meditation can be triggering for trauma survivors. Look for trauma-informed apps that offer grounding meditations, body-based practices, and options to keep eyes open. Start slowly and work with a therapist when possible.

hubs.meta_description: Find the best apps for addiction recovery and sobriety. Compare I Am Sober, Sober Grid, and more tools for maintaining recovery.
hubs.direct_answer: The best recovery apps combine sobriety tracking with community support and coping tools. I Am Sober offers milestone tracking and motivation, while Sober Grid provides peer support from others in recovery.
hubs.intro: Recovery is a journey, and the right tools can provide crucial support. These apps help track your progress, connect with supportive communities, and develop coping skills for maintaining sobriety.

faqs.q: What apps help with addiction recovery?
faqs.a: I Am Sober is excellent for tracking sobriety milestones and daily motivation. Sober Grid offers community support. Many people use both alongside professional treatment and support groups like AA or SMART Recovery.

faqs.q: Can apps replace AA or rehab?
faqs.a: No. Apps are supportive tools that work best alongside professional treatment, therapy, and support groups. They can provide extra accountability and coping resources but aren't substitutes for comprehensive treatment.

faqs.q: Do recovery apps protect my privacy?
faqs.a: Privacy varies by app. We review each app's privacy practices. Look for apps that don't share personal data, offer anonymous options, and have clear data policies. Check our privacy grades for each tool.

hubs.seo_title: Apps for Bipolar, Schizophrenia & SMI 2026 | HeyPsych
hubs.meta_description: Find apps designed for serious mental illness including bipolar disorder and schizophrenia. Mood tracking and symptom management tools.
hubs.direct_answer: eMoods Bipolar Mood Tracker is the leading app for bipolar disorder, offering detailed mood, sleep, and medication tracking. These apps are designed to complement professional treatment for serious mental illness.
hubs.intro: Managing serious mental illness requires specialized tools that work alongside professional treatment. These apps help track symptoms, medications, and early warning signs to support your treatment plan.

faqs.q: What apps help with bipolar disorder?
faqs.a: eMoods Bipolar Mood Tracker is specifically designed for bipolar disorder, tracking mood episodes, sleep, and medications. It generates reports you can share with your treatment provider.

faqs.q: Are there apps for schizophrenia?
faqs.a: Actissist is designed for people with psychosis and schizophrenia, offering symptom tracking and coping strategies. These apps should always be used alongside professional psychiatric treatment.

faqs.q: Should I use apps if I have a serious mental illness?
faqs.a: Apps can be helpful additions to your treatment plan when used under guidance from your mental health provider. They're tools for tracking and support, not replacements for medication and therapy.

hubs.meta_description: Compare online therapy and psychiatry platforms. BetterHelp, Talkspace, Talkiatry, and more options for professional mental health support.
hubs.direct_answer: Online therapy platforms like BetterHelp and Talkspace connect you with licensed therapists via video, phone, or messaging. For psychiatric care including medication, platforms like Talkiatry and Brightside Health offer virtual psychiatry.
hubs.intro: Finding the right mental health support is crucial. These platforms connect you with licensed therapists and psychiatrists online, making professional care more accessible.

faqs.q: Is online therapy as effective as in-person?
faqs.a: Research shows online therapy can be as effective as in-person therapy for many conditions including depression and anxiety. The key is finding a good therapeutic relationship with your provider.

faqs.q: How do I choose between therapy platforms?
faqs.a: Consider: cost and insurance coverage, therapist matching process, communication options (video, phone, messaging), and specialty areas. Read our detailed comparisons to find the best fit.

faqs.q: Can I get psychiatric medication online?
faqs.a: Yes. Platforms like Talkiatry and Brightside Health offer virtual psychiatry with licensed psychiatrists who can prescribe medications. Some medications have restrictions on telehealth prescribing.

sub_hubs.seo_title: Best Online Therapy Platforms 2026 | Compare BetterHelp, Talkspace | HeyPsych
sub_hubs.meta_description: Compare the best online therapy platforms. BetterHelp vs Talkspace, pricing, therapist matching, and insurance coverage.
sub_hubs.direct_answer: BetterHelp and Talkspace are the largest online therapy platforms. BetterHelp offers more therapists and flexible communication, while Talkspace partners with more insurance plans.
sub_hubs.intro: Online therapy makes mental health care accessible from anywhere. Compare platforms based on cost, therapist availability, communication options, and insurance coverage.

faqs.q: How much does online therapy cost?
faqs.a: Without insurance, online therapy typically costs $60-$100 per week for messaging-based plans, or $150-$300 per live session. Many platforms now accept insurance, which can reduce costs significantly.

faqs.q: Does insurance cover online therapy?
faqs.a: Many insurance plans now cover online therapy. Talkspace has the most insurance partnerships. Check with your insurance and the platform to verify coverage before signing up.

sub_hubs.seo_title: Best Online Psychiatry Platforms 2026 | Medication Management | HeyPsych
sub_hubs.meta_description: Compare online psychiatry platforms for medication management. Talkiatry, Brightside Health, and more options for virtual psychiatric care.
sub_hubs.direct_answer: Talkiatry and Brightside Health are leading online psychiatry platforms offering medication management with licensed psychiatrists. Both accept insurance and provide ongoing care.
sub_hubs.intro: If you need psychiatric medication, these platforms connect you with licensed psychiatrists who can evaluate, diagnose, and prescribe medications through secure video visits.

faqs.q: Can psychiatrists prescribe controlled substances online?
faqs.a: Regulations vary by state and medication. Most platforms can prescribe common psychiatric medications. Some controlled substances have restrictions on telehealth prescribing. Check with the platform for your specific needs.

faqs.q: How often do I need appointments?
faqs.a: Initial evaluations typically take 45-60 minutes. Follow-up appointments for medication management are usually monthly at first, then may decrease to quarterly once stable.

sub_hubs.seo_title: Best AI Therapy Apps 2026 | Woebot, Wysa | HeyPsych
sub_hubs.meta_description: Compare AI therapy chatbots like Woebot and Wysa. 24/7 mental health support using CBT techniques. Understand limitations and best uses.
sub_hubs.direct_answer: Woebot and Wysa are the leading AI therapy chatbots, offering 24/7 CBT-based support. They're helpful for mild symptoms and skill-building but aren't replacements for human therapists.
sub_hubs.intro: AI therapy chatbots provide instant, 24/7 mental health support using evidence-based techniques. They're accessible and affordable but have limitations. Understand when they're helpful and when you need human support.

faqs.q: Are AI therapists as good as real therapists?
faqs.a: No. AI chatbots can teach CBT skills and provide support, but they can't provide the therapeutic relationship, complex assessment, or personalized treatment that human therapists offer. They're supplements, not replacements.

faqs.q: When should I use an AI therapist?
faqs.a: AI therapists are helpful for: mild symptoms, learning CBT skills, 24/7 support between therapy sessions, or as a first step while waiting for therapy access. Seek human help for moderate to severe symptoms.
